angles.angle: Bitcoin is an undervalued, apolitical global free market that no authority can control.
Bitcoin is an authority-free global free market whose price is driven by sentiment and macro risk appetite.
Bitcoin is a new internet/global free market that no authority controls and is undervalued, even if markets treat it as risky.

takeaways.text: To me, this medley still points to a quiet, borderless market whose worth is decided by participants, not officials, and that makes today's widespread skepticism look quite badly misplaced.
What stands out is how rare it is for any system to resist capture by those who usually hold power. That rarity makes it fascinating, suggests a different value.
